evidence.section: Results - Microstructure After Annealing at 800°C and 1000°C
evidence.quote: After annealing at 800 °C (Figure 4(a)), continuous precipitates on GB and spheroidal precipitates densely distributed within grain can be observed.

evidence.section: Results - Microstructure After Annealing at 800°C and 1000°C
evidence.quote: continuous precipitates on GB and spheroidal precipitates densely distributed within grain can be observed.
The continuous flat GB precipitations transform into a ''fishbone'' shape.
the nearly spherical particles with a small size ( ~ 311 nm) are dispersed inside the grain

when deformed at 1000 °C, the strength of the alloys annealed at 600 °C for 24 h (H600-24) and 120 h (H600-120) is 165 and 154 MPa, respectively, which are 19 and 30 MPa higher than the as-cast alloy 135 MPa, respectively.
